key_insight: TextSeal2 strengthens distortion-free LLM watermark detection while preserving output diversity and surviving speculative decoding without changing acceptance rates.
engineering_relevance: It supports watermarking in accelerated LLM serving with no measurable inference latency and no post-logits optimization.
method: Merge multiple watermark keys into one virtual key instead of selecting a key by coin flip.
Couple the virtual key to fresh noise using AutoMark’s Gaussian copula.
Verify speculative drafts with an additional exponential race on leftover draft races, using memorylessness to preserve the target distribution.
evidence_signal: Across three LLMs, detection improved by 8–22 percentage points over TextSeal for 100-token answers at matched diversity and a 0.001 false-positive rate; under speculative decoding, gains were 18 points over TextSeal and 22 over textGrain for 200-token answers at matched acceptance rates.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish robustness to paraphrasing or other watermark-removal attacks.
paper_title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
